children: Whop, operator of an online business platform and digital marketplace, announced a $200 million Series D funding round at a $5.1 billion valuation.

The round was led by Sequoia and Shopify Ventures, Whop said. The latest round is Whop's second fundraising of the year, following a $200 strategic investment from Tether at a $1.6 billion valuation in February, the company added.
The new funds will be used to accelerate global expansion and research and development efforts to make payment and advertising markets more efficient, the company said.
Whop said it launched its Business Blueprints service six weeks ago, adding more than 21,000 businesses since the launch.
Whop also said it facilitates more than $7 billion in on-platform transactions to people in 185 countries.
